comment: At shared Adam displacement Δ=0.06144 and equal d_model=128, feedforward width was the strongest discriminator: D’s 256 outranked the 128-width pair C/A, which outranked the 64-width pair B/E. K1017 supported larger d_ff in this regime. K1069 supplied the weaker fewer-heads tie-break, favoring C over A and B over E. K1017 explicitly treats depth at Δ=0.02–0.1 as uncertain, so a blanket preference for fewer layers was unnecessary. The gold agrees with these existing scoped rules; no new general hypothesis is warranted.
